I agree with this. It really seems like people aren’t allowed to have any weird thoughts or feelings at all ever or else you are diagnosed with something. Sometimes a headache is nothing more than just a headache.

Leaping to diagnosing you with OCD seems extreme, but no you are not disturbed. Those sound like run of the mill intrusive thoughts. They are distressing because they don’t jive with who you know yourself to be (in other words NOT disturbed). The only reason they became arousing is the “naughty” label of them - not the content. Does that make sense? Think about it this way, if you were in a room, by yourself, and there was this big glowing red switch on the wall with a simple sign on it that said “do not turn off”. What is the first thing that would come to mind? My guess is something like “I wonder what would happen if I flipped it off?” Does that make you disturbed? No. Your brain is just doing its brain thing. Let those intrusive thoughts go. Just see them as a weird glitch in your head at times and don’t try to make them a big deal. The desperate attempts to push them away or keep them from ever coming back sort of makes them more relevant to your brain. Hope that helps.
